scope: Strengthen the UNDERLAY OBJECTS allocation sweep with caller-graph preservation and clean-byte retry assertions across admitted target revisions, including the AC1021 DWF-only profile.

source.kind: deterministic locally-authored in-memory dx_data graph generated during each test run
source.profile: Three rooted underlay definition dictionaries and typed PDF, DGN, and DWF definitions and instances at AC1024/AC1027/AC1032; one rooted DWF definition and instance at AC1021, matching the writer's admitted-kind gate. Profiles use distinct handles, filenames, sheet names, positions, scale, extrusion vector, and clip bounds.

implementation.method: Validate the full generated root/dictionary/definition/instance graph before and after clean calibration, every injected allocation failure, and same-adapter retry. Require destination-sentinel preservation on failure; compare retry bytes with clean bytes; fresh-import typed readback checks every underlay-to-definition edge and kind.

versionBoundaryProbe.AC1021: DWF-only generated profile admitted and exercised; PDF and DGN are refused by the existing writer version gate.
versionBoundaryProbe.qualificationEffect: Transaction evidence covers only the locally generated admitted-kind profiles; no claim about producer prevalence or native support.
